## The Story: Twins Separated by Fate

The narrative begins with Shiva and Marion, identical twins born from a secret relationship between an Indian nun and an English surgeon within a mission hospital in Ethiopia. Though initially linked at birth, fate intervenes to separate them at the critical moment. Orphaned on the day of their arrival and abandoned by their father that very day, these two boys share not only a profound connection but also a mutual passion for medicine.

As they mature through the political upheavals shaking Ethiopia during the 1960s and 70s, their lives become complicated further by their love for Genet, their foster daughter. When Genet becomes involved in the struggle for Eritrean liberation, she ultimately separates the twins' paths. Marion, freshly graduated from medical school, is forced to flee to America.

Through repeated dramatic encounters orchestrated by Genet, Shiva and Marion are eventually reunited.
